blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Long-term personalization requires language models to use interaction history to track users' preferences across sessions. Parametric memory encodes this interaction history into model parameters or adapters, reducing the need to include it in the inference context. However, independent context compilation leaves cross-session integration unspecified, while recurrent updates can attenuate earlier evidence. To address these challenges, we propose Dual-Path Parametric Memory (DPPM). Its Evidence path directly pools representations of the interaction history to preserve earlier evidence, while its Delta path sequentially updates an associative state to capture changes. Fusing both outputs produces history-conditioned LoRA adapters that combine evidence accumulation with ordered revision. Across multiple backbones, DPPM outperforms the evaluated baselines, achieving 54.22% on PersonaMem-v2 and 86.79% on PrefEval. These results suggest that DPPM provides a simple and effective design choice for cross-session personalized parametric memory.
blocks.zh: 长期个性化需要语言模型使用交互历史来跟踪用户在会话中的偏好. 参数内存将这个相互作用历史编码为模型参数或适配器,减少了将其纳入推论上下文的需要. 然而,独立的上下文汇编没有指明跨会集,而经常性的更新会削弱早先的证据. 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议采用双面参数记忆。 它的证据路径直接集合了互动历史的表示,以保存早期的证据,而其德尔塔路径则依序更新一个关联状态以捕捉变化. 利用这两种产出,可以产生符合历史条件的LORA适配器,将证据积累与有秩序的修订结合起来。 在多个骨干部门中,DPM的表现超过了评估的基线,PersonaMem-v2达到54.22%,PrefEval达到86.79%。 这些结果表明,DPM为跨会场个性化参数记忆提供了简单有效的设计选择.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: As large language models (LLMs) become persistent personal assistants, personalization increasingly depends on long-term memory. Such memory must preserve users’ preferences, backgrounds, and constraints across sessions to inform subsequent responses ( Liu et al., 2026a ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . To support this continuity, existing systems maintain textual records and construct response contexts through summarization, retrieval, or explicit memory editing ( Zhong et al., 2023 ; Packer et al., 2024 ; Chhikara et al., 2025 ) . While these records are easy to inspect and maintain, their effectiveness depends on accurate extraction, retrieval, and contextual reasoning, and including more of the interaction history increases inference-time context costs.
blocks.zh: 随着大型语言模型(LLMs)成为持久的个人助理,个性化越来越依赖于长期的记忆. 这种记忆必须保留用户的喜好、背景和各种限制,以便为随后的反应提供参考(刘等,2026a; 陈等,2026). 为支持这种连续性,现有系统通过汇总、检索或明确的内存编辑来维持文字记录并构建反应环境(Zhong等,2023;Packer等,2024;Chhikara等,2025)。 虽然这些记录易于检查和维护,但其有效性取决于准确的取出,检索,以及背景推理,包括更多的相互作用历史会增加推断时间背景成本.

blocks.en: To reduce reliance on the interaction history at inference time, alternative approaches encode it into parameters, adapters, or internal states along two directions. Context compilation methods, such as Doc-to-LoRA ( Charakorn et al., 2026 ) and SHINE ( Liu et al., 2026b ) , use hypernetworks to map individual contexts to LoRA adapters. State maintenance methods integrate information sequentially. RPMem ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) recurrently consolidates session representations into memory adapters, while Metis ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) updates memory matrices within the backbone.
blocks.zh: 为了减少在推断时间对相互作用历史的依赖,其他方法将其编码为参数,适配器,或沿着两个方向的内部状态. 上下文编译方法,如Doc-to-Lora(Charakorn等,2026年)和SHINE(Liu等,2026年b),使用超网络将单个上下文映射到LORA适配器. 国家维护方法依次整合信息. RPMem (Zhao等,2026年)经常将会话表述整合为内存适配器,而Metis (Zhang等,2026年)更新了骨干内部的内存矩阵.

blocks.en: Despite advances in encoding interaction history and updating memory across sessions, two limitations remain. First, independently compiling segments into adapters does not itself support selective retention and revision as new sessions arrive ( Charakorn et al., 2026 ) . Second, recurrent consolidation enables revision, but successive updates to a shared state can attenuate earlier contributions ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . These limitations motivate preserving direct access to earlier evidence while supporting selective revision as the interaction history grows.
blocks.zh: 尽管在编译交互历史和在各个会话中更新内存方面取得了进展,但仍然存在两个局限性. 首先,独立地将部分汇编成适配器本身并不支持随着新会话的到来进行选择性保留和修订(Charakorn等,2026年)。 第二,经常合并使修订成为可能,但连续更新到共享状态则会减少先前的捐款(赵等,2026;杨等,2025)。 这些限制促使人们保留直接获取早期证据的机会,同时支持随着互动历史的增长而进行选择性修订。

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we propose Dual-Path Parametric Memory (DPPM), which separates evidence accumulation from sequential state updates within a unified parametric memory interface. The Evidence path directly aggregates representations of the interaction history, while the Delta path maintains an associative state in chronological order. Their outputs jointly form the final memory, combining accumulated evidence with order-dependent updates.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们提出"双相参数内存"(DPPM),将证据积累和相继状态更新区分在一个统一的参数内存界面内. "证据"路径直接汇总了互动历史的表示,而"德尔塔"路径则按时间顺序保持了关联状态. 其产出共同构成最终记忆,将所积累的证据与依订单更新相结合.

blocks.en: Specifically, DPPM learns cross-session memory consolidation on top of a frozen Doc-to-LoRA compiler, avoiding additional compiler training. The compiler encodes chronological segments of the interaction history into representations shared by both paths. In the Evidence path, coordinate-wise, content-dependent weighting directly aggregates these representations, allowing early evidence to contribute without passing through successive state updates. In the Delta path, the same segment representations are processed in chronological order. A content-derived associative key retrieves a prediction of the current segment representation from the existing state, and the prediction residual is written back to capture order-dependent changes. Finally, learnable fusion and scale calibration combine the two outputs, and a frozen decoder converts the fused memory into history-conditioned LoRA adapters for personalized generation. Training updates only the lightweight memory modules, while the compiler, decoder, and language-model backbone remain frozen.
blocks.zh: 具体来说,DPM在被冷冻的Doc-to-LORA编译器上学习跨会话内存整合,避免了额外的编译器训练. 编译器将交互历史的时间段编码为两条路径共有的表示. 在"证据"路径中,基于协调,内容的权重直接汇总了这些表述,使得早期证据可以在不经过相继的状态更新的情况下作出贡献. 在 Delta 路径中,按时间顺序处理同一段表示. 由内容衍生的关联键从现有状态中检索出对当前分块代表的预测,而预测剩余部分被写回,以捕捉依赖命令的变化. 最后,可学习的聚变和尺度校正结合了两种输出,被冷冻的解码器将被熔化的内存转换为历史条件的LORA适配器,用于个性化生成. 训练只更新轻量级内存模块,而编译器,解码器,和语言模型骨干仍然被冻结.

blocks.en: We evaluate DPPM on PersonaMem-v2 ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) and PrefEval ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) across three backbones spanning different architectures and model sizes (2B–7B parameters). With Qwen3-4B, DPPM outperforms the evaluated baselines, achieving 54.22% accuracy on PersonaMem-v2 and 86.79% accuracy on PrefEval. These results suggest that DPPM offers a simple and effective approach to cross-session personalized parametric memory. In summary, this work makes the following three key contributions: (1) We propose DPPM, separating evidence accumulation from sequential updates for cross-session memory without compiler retraining. (2) We analyze how direct accumulation mitigates evidence attenuation and sequential updates capture order-dependent changes. (3) We validate DPPM across benchmarks, model architectures, and scales through ablations and controlled experiments.
blocks.zh: 我们对PersonaMem-v2(Jiang等,2025年)和PrefEval(Zhao等,2025年)的DPM的评价跨越了跨越不同建筑和模型大小(2B-7B参数)的三个骨干. 随着Qune3-4B的出现,DPM的表现超过了评估的基线,PersonaMem-v2的精度达到54.22%,PrefEval的精度达到86.79%. 这些结果表明DPM为跨会场个性化参数记忆提供了简单而有效的方法. 总而言之,这项工作作出以下三项主要贡献: (1)我们提出DPM,将证据积累与相继更新分开,用于跨会话记忆,而无需编译器再培训. (2)我们分析直接积累如何能减轻证据的减弱并相继更新捕获顺序所依赖的变化. (3) 我们通过模拟和控制实验,通过基准、模型结构和尺度验证DPM。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Following RPMem ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) , we use the processed PersonaMem-v2 32K-Text split ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) with 18,527 training, 2,059 validation, and 5,000 test examples, excluding test personas from training and validation. PrefEval ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) uses a fixed topic split (seed 42), with 16 training and four held-out topics. Three preference forms at 10, 70, and 300 turns yield 7,380 training and 1,620 test instances.
blocks.zh: 继RPMem(赵等,2026年)后,我们采用经过处理的PersonaMem-v2 32K-Text分拆(Jiang等,2025年),经过18,527个培训,2,059个验证,5000个测试实例,不包括测试人的培训与验证. PrefEval (Zhao等,2025年)使用固定的话题分出(种子42),有16个培训和4个被搁置的话题. 在10分、70分和300分的三种优惠形式中,有7 380次培训和1 620次测试。

blocks.en: We compare No Context and Full Context, textual memories from Rolling Summary following RPMem ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) , top-10 BGE-M3 retrieval ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , Mem0 ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ) , and LightMem ( Fang et al., 2026 ) . Parametric baselines include D2L ( Charakorn et al., 2026 ) , PLUME ( Shi et al., 2026 ) , RPMem ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) , δ \delta -mem ( Lei et al., 2026 ) , and Metis ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . For a fair comparison, our RPMem baseline uses the same frozen D2L encoder as DPPM, without additional encoder-training data. We use released checkpoints for δ \delta -mem and Metis. Gold State provides annotated user state as a reference.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that DPPM reaches 54.22% on PersonaMem-v2 and 86.79% on PrefEval, improving over RPMem by 8.50 and 4.32 percentage points. The improvement extends across all seven reported metrics, including both information about the focal user and the currently valid state. On PrefEval, the advantage remains positive at every dialogue interval, including a 3.67-point gain after 300 intervening turns. Thus, the overall result reflects benefits across several evaluation conditions rather than a single favorable subset.
blocks.zh: 表1显示,PersonaMem-v2和PrefEval的DPM比例分别达到54.22%和86.79%,比RPMem增长了8.50%和4.32个百分点。 这一改进涉及所有七个已报告的衡量标准,包括关于协调人用户和目前有效状态的信息。 在PrefEval上,每个对话间隔的优势仍然是积极的,包括300个中间转弯后3.67分的收益. 因此,总体结果反映了若干评价条件的效益,而不是一个有利的子集。

blocks.en: The strongest textual baseline differs across benchmarks, with Full Context leading on PersonaMem-v2 and Mem0 on PrefEval. DPPM exceeds their Overall scores by 21.26 and 11.30 points, respectively. Providing or retrieving text from the interaction history therefore leaves substantial room for better personalization in these settings. Direct D2L also trails the trained consolidation methods, suggesting that compiling the interaction history into parameters benefits from learning how its segments should be integrated for downstream answers. The significance comparison with RPMem appears in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 最强的文字基线因基准而异,Full Context在PersonaMem-v2和Mem0在PrefEval上领先. DPPM分别比其总分多出21.26分和11.30分. 因此,提供或检索互动历史中的案文,为在这些环境中更好地个性化留下了很大的空间。 直接D2L还跟踪经过培训的合并方法,这表明,将相互作用历史汇编成参数,有助于了解如何将各部分纳入下游答案。 与RPMem的重大比较见附录C。

blocks.en: Table 2 compares the four memory designs within each backbone and its released compiler. DPPM outperforms RPMem on both benchmarks for Gemma, Qwen, and Mistral. The gains range from 8.50 to 13.98 points on PersonaMem-v2 and from 4.19 to 5.31 points on PrefEval. The largest gains occur with Mistral, while Gemma confirms gains with a smaller backbone.

blocks.en: Architectural ablations use Evidence only and Delta only as single-path controls to examine the complementarity of the two memory mechanisms. Their relative strengths vary across tasks and backbones, indicating that direct evidence accumulation and sequential state updates provide distinct memory signals. Combining both paths improves PersonaMem-v2 Overall over either standalone variant on all three backbones and PrefEval Overall on Qwen and Mistral. On Qwen, DPPM exceeds the stronger standalone path by 4.45 and 0.81 percentage points, respectively. These results support combining complementary memory signals to enhance cross-session personalization.
blocks.zh: 建筑浮雕只使用"证据"和"三角洲"作为单行道控制,以审查两种记忆机制的互补性. 他们的相对优势因任务和骨干而异,表明直接证据积累和相继状态更新提供了独特的内存信号. 将这两条路径结合起来可以改善PersonaMem-v2,总体而言,这三条主干线要么是独立的变体,要么是Quen和Mistral上的PrefEval总体。 在Qwen上,DPM分别以4.45和0.81个百分点的成绩超过了更强大的独立路径. 这些成果支持将互补的记忆信号结合起来,以加强跨会场个性化.

blocks.en: To examine whether DPPM’s gains arise from a larger trainable budget, we compare the memory modules under the same frozen Qwen3-4B compiler–decoder interface. blocks.en: Figure 3 links DPPM’s gains to the appropriate use of accumulated evidence. In PersonaMem-v2, Forget tests whether responses respect requests to stop using prior information, Sensitive tests restraint in using private details, and Therapy tests personalization from individual background ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) . DPPM improves these categories over RPMem by 21.68, 17.57, and 15.34 points, respectively. The Others subset tests whether information about another person is incorrectly attributed to the user; accuracy rises from 13.68% to 50.23%. These results indicate that much of DPPM’s improvement comes from better attribution and more appropriate revision of memory use.
blocks.zh: 图3将DPM的收益与适当使用所积累的证据联系起来。 在PersonaMem-v2中,不考虑答复是否尊重停止使用先前信息的要求、使用私人细节的敏感测试限制、以及从个人背景进行个人化治疗测试(Jiang等人,2025年)。 DPPM比RPMem分别提高了21.68分,17.57分和15.34分. 其他分类测试关于另一人的信息是否被错误地归因于用户;准确度从13.68%上升到50.23%。 这些结果表明,DPM的改进大部分来自更好的归属和对内存使用的更适当的修改.

blocks.en: This pattern aligns with our motivation to preserve evidence while revising its applicability. The Evidence path gives earlier representations direct access to the final memory, while Delta supplies ordered updates as new interactions arrive. DPPM also outperforms both single-path controls on Others and Forget, supporting their complementary roles. On PrefEval, the four topics test preference following in different application domains ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) . Gains across all four, from 1.90 points on Technology to 6.50 on Education, show broader use of remembered preferences. Alongside the latent-retention results below, these findings support combining evidence accumulation and state revision for personalization.
blocks.zh: 这种模式符合我们在修订其适用性的同时保留证据的动机。 证据路径让更早的表达可以直接访问最终内存,而德尔塔供给则在新的互动到达时命令更新. DPM还超越了对他人的单行道控制和遗忘,支持其互补作用. 在PrefEval上,四个专题测试不同应用领域的偏好(Zhao等,2025年)。 从1.90分技术到6.50分教育这四个方面都取得了进步,这表明人们更广泛地利用了人们记忆中的偏好。 除了以下潜在的保留结果外,这些结论还支持将证据积累和州修订结合起来,以便个性化。

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: 5.1 Personalized Memory
blocks.zh: 5.1 个性化记忆

blocks.en: Personalized memory must distill growing histories into useful information for future responses. MemoryBank and MemGPT maintain persistent records and retrieve relevant content when needed ( Zhong et al., 2023 ; Packer et al., 2024 ) . As records accumulate, storage must be complemented by content selection and revision. Mem0 and A-MEM address these needs through memory extraction, organization, and updating ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) . Recent work learns adaptive memory strategies that balance shared knowledge and individual needs ( Xu et al., 2026 ; Han et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 个性化的记忆必须把不断增长的历史提炼成有用的信息,供今后作出反应。 MemoryBank和MemGPT保持持久性记录并在需要时检索相关内容(Zhong等,2023;Packer等,2024.). 随着记录的积累,存储必须辅之以内容选择和修订. Mem0和A-MEM通过内存提取、组织和更新满足这些需要(Chhikara等,2025;Xu等,2025)。 近期的工作学习了适应性记忆战略,兼顾共享知识和个人需要(徐等,2026;韩等,2026.

blocks.en: These developments broaden evaluation from recalling history to using it appropriately. LoCoMo and LongMemEval assess conversational recall and reasoning ( Maharana et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) , while PrefEval and PersonaMem-v2 examine preference following and implicit personalization ( Zhao et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) . Evolving preferences and multi-user decisions introduce further demands on memory maintenance ( Liu et al., 2026a ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . We approach these demands through parametric memory for cross-session personalization.
blocks.zh: 这些事态发展扩大了评价范围,从回顾历史到适当利用历史。 LoCoMo和LongMemEval评估对话召回和推理(Maharana等人,2024年;Wu等人,2025年;PrefEval和PersonaMem-v2审查顺从和隐含的个性化(Zhao等人,2025年;Jiang等人,2025年)。 不断变化的偏好和多用户决定对内存维护提出了进一步要求(Liu等,2026a; 陈等,2026). 我们通过跨会场个性化的参数记忆来满足这些需求.

blocks.en: 5.2 Parametric Memory
blocks.zh: 5.2 参数内存

blocks.en: Encoding information into parameters reduces reliance on interaction history at inference time, but requires an effective writing mechanism. ROME and MEMIT edit factual associations ( Meng et al., 2023a ; Meng et al., 2023b ) , while FastMem internalizes prompts through optimization ( Zhu et al., 2024 ) . To avoid repeated optimization, Doc-to-LoRA and SHINE learn context-to-adapter hypernetworks that generate LoRA parameters in a forward pass ( Charakorn et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 将信息编码为参数会减少在推断时间对交互历史的依赖,但需要有效的写作机制. ROME和MEMIT编辑事实社团(Meng等,2023a; Meng等, 2023b ),而FastMem通过优化(Zhu等, 2024)进行内化促进. 为避免重复优化,Doc-to-Lora和SHINE在前行通道中学习产生LORA参数的上下文-适应器超网络(Charakorn等,2026;Liu等,2026b.).

blocks.en: Efficient writing alone does not determine how accumulated memory should evolve. Sequential state updates address this requirement through associative rules in Fast Weight Programmers and Gated DeltaNet ( Schlag et al., 2021 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) , and learned adaptation in TTT and Titans ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Behrouz et al., 2024 ) . Building on state maintenance, Metis integrates forward-updated memory into the backbone ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . RPMem, the work closest to ours, connects recurrent session consolidation with adapter generation ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . DPPM extends this approach with direct evidence accumulation alongside sequential revision, reducing reliance on a single recurrent state.
blocks.zh: 仅仅高效地写作并不能决定积累的内存应如何演变. 序列状态更新通过快重程序员和Gated DeltaNet中的关联规则(Schlag等,2021;Yang等,2025;TTT和Titans中学习到的适应(Sun等,2025;Behrouz等,2024))解决了这一要求. 在状态维护的基础上,梅蒂斯将前置更新的内存整合入骨干(张等,2026. 与我们最相近的作品RPMem将经常性会话整合与适配器生成相接(赵等,2026). DPPM将这种方法扩展为在相继修订的同时直接积累证据,从而减少对单一经常状态的依赖.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduced DPPM for integrating interaction history across sessions in personalized language models. DPPM combines evidence accumulation and sequential updates for retention and revision without extra compiler training. Experiments across two benchmarks and backbones of different architectures and sizes demonstrate its effectiveness, while theoretical analysis and controlled experiments support the complementary roles of the two paths. These findings highlight the value of preserving historical evidence while adapting its use, offering a practical design for long-term personalized parametric memory.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了DPPM,将各会间互动历史整合到个性化语言模型中. DPPM将证据积累和相继更新结合起来,用于保留和修订,而不进行额外的编译培训. 跨越不同架构和大小的两种基准和主干线的实验显示了其有效性,而理论分析和受控实验则支持了两种路径的互补作用. 这些发现凸显了保留历史证据同时调整其用途的价值,为长期个性化参数记忆提供了实用设计.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Although DPPM advances cross-session personalization through dual-path memory, our study has two limitations. First, computational constraints limit DPPM experiments to 2B–7B backbones, leaving larger-scale validation for future work. Second, our memory interface currently processes textual interaction histories. Extending it to images and speech is a natural next step.
blocks.zh: 虽然DPPM通过双路径记忆推进了跨会场个性化,但我们的研究却有两个局限性. 首先,计算限制将DPM实验限制在2B–7B骨干上,为未来工作留下更大规模的验证. 第二,我们的内存界面目前处理文本交互历史. 把它推广到图像和语音上是自然的下一步.
